constraint: Same model architecture, policy function, parameter count and default 64 visits; preserve current response speed.
hypothesis: Calibrate only the existing win/draw/loss head using the later normal-position replay data while freezing all representation/policy/score/ownership parameters. Avoid policy drift that affected earlier full-model fine-tuning.

training.selection: Minimum normal common-target validation loss at epochs 0/4/8/12/16/20/24; frozen non-value parameters make policy/score/ownership terms constant. Epoch zero is eligible; stop if all parameters remain unchanged.

search: Use the pending-aware original virtual-loss search (previous 48-game development result 24/24 with original model), not the virtual-mean candidate. FPU 1, unchanged exploration coefficient 1.5.

evaluation.selection: No match-based tuning. One validation-selected candidate only.

adoption: Paired bootstrap lower 95% bound >0.5; each board >=12/32; no caps/illegal moves; exact equality of all non-value parameters and policy outputs; same fixed-root CPU/WebGPU speed gate as batch-search (aggregate P95 <=1.05, each board <=1.10).
